name: Ogata Sayaka
source:
A new nurse who begins working at “Date Clinic,” where the protagonist has been assigned.

Although she’s clumsy and constantly makes mistakes, her kind nature and cheerful, ever-smiling demeanor earn her a good reputation among patients.

In exchange for helping her sick mother, she agrees to fulfill the protagonist’s request to serve as a “comfort nurse”.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/9184/?gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
